comment: Per-app allow list for the resource-level factory. An entry means: this package may be restyled by an RRO built by repo/tools/theme-factory, and someone checked that the result was usable. sha256 pins the exact APK that was analysed; a different build only warns, it does not block (the lead pulls new APKs after every ROM update).

notes: current LineageOS/F-Droid package id; the historical org.lineageos.etar id was renamed
AOSP Calendar Java namespace com.android.calendar survives in the activity name
declares no <overlayable> -> preinstalled overlay may map any resource
Material3 theme + optional Monet themes; Monet styles set theme attrs to @android:color/system_* in their (v31) bag, which a value overlay cannot re-point (see docs/23-theme-factory.md §5)
same app, same resource names; only the manifest package differs
kept here so an older device dump is not silently refused; analyse first
Settings already has a hand-written RRO; the factory is not the owner of that surface
